flatten_pytree_structure: flatten a nested python dict, list, or tuple into a flat list of leaves and a TreeSpec for reconstruction
unflatten_leaves_to_pytree: unflatten a flat list of values back into a nested pytree using a previously saved TreeSpec
map_function_over_pytree_leaves: map a function over all leaves of a nested pytree and return a new pytree with transformed values
map_function_only_on_type_leaves: map a function only over leaves matching a specific type (e.g., Tensor) while leaving other leaves unchanged
serialize_deserialize_treespec: serialize a TreeSpec to a JSON string and deserialize it back for storage or transmission
